source: User-supplied job-alert PDF dated 1 November 2026; role labels and short duty excerpts only. No personalized email links retained.

courses.title: Software Engineering Lecturer Practice
courses.summary: Teach requirements, testable software design and digital image processing through a reproducible classroom project.
courses.prerequisites: A relevant computing qualification or equivalent software-development experience; basic Python and Git.
courses.environment: Python 3.12 or later, Git, a text editor; no third-party Python packages required. OpenCV 4.13 documentation is an extension reading.
evidence: Boundary-test table and corrected booking function
Design decision record and operation-count comparison
Reproducible image-filter worksheet with border policy
A 20-minute image-processing lesson, test suite and moderated marking guide
courses.capstone: Design and teach a 20-minute lesson that takes a 5 by 5 grayscale image through a documented filter. Learners must predict the centre value, run the implementation and diagnose a deliberate border-policy defect. Submit a requirements-to-test matrix, an accessible learner handout and a five-case test suite.
courses.critical: Unlicensed source images, private learner data or untested numerical claims require correction before assessment.

courses.title: Mathematics for IT Lecturers
courses.summary: Make discrete logic, vectors and conditional probability teachable through worked computing examples and misconception-led feedback.
courses.prerequisites: Algebra, functions and introductory probability; experience explaining quantitative reasoning.
courses.environment: A calculator, spreadsheet or Python 3.12 or later; paper working is a complete alternative.
evidence: Truth table, counterexample and repaired rule
Annotated vector transformation and invariant check
Frequency table and explained posterior probability
A diagnostic-led mini-lesson and moderated mathematics assessment
courses.capstone: Teach a 20-minute lesson on interpreting a positive screening result using a fictional population. Provide both a frequency table and a probability derivation; diagnose confusion between sensitivity and the probability of a condition after a positive result. Add one transfer problem with different prevalence and a transparent partial-credit rubric.
courses.critical: Incorrect denominators or a worked solution that conflicts with the stated assumptions must be corrected.

courses.title: Academic Copy Editing and Source Verification
courses.summary: Copy edit academic material with an explicit style sheet, claim checks, accessible structures and controlled editorial handover.
courses.prerequisites: Strong written English, document editing skills and familiarity with academic referencing.
courses.environment: A word processor with tracked changes or a plain-text editor and diff; a browser for primary-source checks. Use only synthetic or authorized documents.
modules: Editorial scope, style and author queries
evidence: Edited passage, style sheet and query log
Claim-to-source ledger with uncertainty decisions
Accessible before-and-after technical handout
A release packet containing clean copy, changes, queries and QA checklist
courses.capstone: Edit an original 700-word teaching handout supplied by your assessor or written for this exercise. Include one numerical example, one table, two genuine references and three deliberately ambiguous claims. Deliver tracked and clean versions, a style sheet, a claim ledger and a release recommendation that separates resolved edits from author decisions.
courses.critical: Fabricated citations, silently changed assessment meaning or release of personal data prevents release.

courses.title: IT Lecturer Practice and Assessment
courses.summary: Plan aligned IT lessons, facilitate safe labs and produce defensible assessment and moderation evidence.
courses.prerequisites: Competence in one IT subject and basic document/spreadsheet skills; prior teaching is useful but not required.
courses.environment: Text editor, Python 3.12 or later for the demonstration, and an offline or institution-approved teaching workspace.
evidence: Outcome-to-evidence map and timed lesson plan
Lab readiness checklist, hint ladder and recovery plan
Rubric, two synthetic marked scripts and moderation decision
A teaching portfolio and observed microteaching session
courses.capstone: Deliver a 20-minute lesson on validating a small CSV import. Include a diagnostic question, a worked example, guided practice and an independent transfer task. Submit a timed plan, accessible handout, fault-recovery guide, rubric and moderation record for two fictional student submissions.
courses.critical: Public learner records, unsafe lab instructions or unverifiable grades must be corrected before release.

courses.title: Robotics Lecturer Practice
courses.summary: Teach robot motion, feedback control and fail-safe state machines using deterministic software simulations.
courses.prerequisites: Basic Python, algebra, vectors and introductory electronics concepts.
courses.environment: Python 3.12 or later; simulation only. Physical robotics and ROS installations are optional extensions requiring a separate supervised safety plan.
evidence: Pose trace with units and frame annotations
Controller response table and bounded-command test
State-transition table and fault-injection evidence
A safe simulated robotics lesson with assessed recovery tasks
courses.capstone: Teach a 20-minute simulated robot-control lesson. Learners must predict motion, tune a bounded proportional controller and demonstrate that an invalid sensor reading produces a stopped state. Deliver deterministic tests, a state diagram, a lesson plan and an assessment requiring explanation of simulation limitations.
courses.critical: Connecting the exercise to physical actuators without a separate approved safety plan, or failing to stop on invalid input, prevents completion.

courses.title: Security and Network Engineering Lecturer Practice
courses.summary: Teach subnet planning, access decisions and evidence-led incident diagnosis in isolated fictional networks.
courses.prerequisites: TCP/IP fundamentals, subnetting and basic security concepts; the job alert mentions a relevant MSc requirement, which this course does not replace.
courses.environment: Python 3.12 or later with its standard library; supplied synthetic logs. No scanning, packet capture or changes to production networks are required.
evidence: Non-overlapping subnet plan and access matrix
Allow/deny cases with authentication and authorization reasoning
Timeline, competing hypotheses and verification plan
A segmented-network teaching scenario and incident assessment
courses.capstone: Teach a 20-minute scenario about a fictional campus laboratory that can resolve a service name but receives HTTP 403. Provide subnet and policy diagrams, synthetic evidence and an assessment that distinguishes transport reachability, TLS identity and application authorization. Require a least-privilege correction and a rollback check.
courses.critical: Scanning third-party infrastructure, collecting real credentials or widening access without authorization prevents completion.

courses.title: IT Hardware and Software Lecturer Practice
courses.summary: Connect computer architecture, operating-system troubleshooting and Java data structures to measurable classroom demonstrations.
courses.prerequisites: Computer hardware and operating-system fundamentals; basic Java syntax.
courses.environment: Python 3.12 or later and JDK 17 or later. Optional disposable Linux VM for read-only inspection; no hardware disassembly or privileged changes.
evidence: Bottleneck calculation and bounded performance claim
Hypothesis-driven diagnostic record and recovery plan
Runnable Java search comparison and collection choice
A systems lesson connecting observed performance to algorithms
courses.capstone: Teach a 20-minute lesson explaining why an application is slow. Compare a memory-capacity hypothesis with algorithmic operation counts, demonstrate Java linear and binary search on a sorted dataset, and ask learners to justify a collection choice. Supply the source, expected results, a troubleshooting decision tree and a moderated rubric.
courses.critical: Destructive operating-system commands, unsafe electrical work or unqualified performance claims require remediation.

courses.title: Python Programming Lecturer Practice
courses.summary: Teach Python through execution tracing, explicit contracts, robust file handling and reproducible tests.
courses.prerequisites: Basic programming and Python syntax; ability to run a script in a terminal.
courses.environment: Python 3.12 or later and a text editor. Examples use the standard library and are checked against Python 3.14 documentation.
evidence: Execution trace explaining aliasing and mutation
Validated function with boundary and exception cases
Temporary-file tests for a CSV importer
A microteaching portfolio with a tested Python learning task
courses.capstone: Teach a 20-minute lesson on a CSV score importer. Require learners to distinguish missing files, missing columns and invalid numeric values, test a boundary case and explain one aliasing bug. Submit runnable standard-library code, a test suite, an accessible trace diagram and a rubric that rewards reasoning as well as output.
courses.critical: Silently accepting invalid input, leaking real learner data or fabricating test evidence requires correction.
